title: Email body becomes untrusted agent instruction source
abstract_chain: external sender sends ordinary-looking email
email body or signature contains instruction-like text
email agent classifies, labels, drafts, or forwards based on the email
downstream action occurs without separating content from command
defensive_focus: treat all email body text as untrusted observations
separate classification from action execution
require approval for external-email-driven replies, forwards, file writes, or SaaS actions
safety_note: Use synthetic emails and canary phrases only.

title: Hidden email text changes AI summary or phishing warning
abstract_chain: HTML email includes hidden or low-visibility text
AI assistant summarizes email for user
hidden text changes summary wording or injects a fake security warning
user sees AI-generated message as trusted assistant output
defensive_focus: strip hidden text before summary or label it as hidden
show source snippets for summary claims
block summaries that contain credential or payment instructions absent from visible text
safety_note: Do not send real phishing emails; use local fixtures.

title: Calendar invite description drives agent scheduling or message action
abstract_chain: external meeting invite includes description or notes
calendar/email agent reads invite to find scheduling action items
description contains instruction-like text
agent creates follow-up, sends message, or changes calendar state
defensive_focus: treat calendar descriptions as untrusted content
require user confirmation for invite-driven outbound messages
attribute all suggested actions to invite source

title: Malicious AI browser extension reads AI chat and Gmail DOM
abstract_chain: user installs AI sidebar, VPN, or assistant extension
extension has broad host permissions or remote iframe logic
user opens AI chat or Gmail
extension reads prompts, responses, email content, tabs, or internal URLs
data is sent to external endpoint
defensive_focus: inventory extensions with AI and email host permissions
block remote code and iframe-based extension UIs
monitor DOM reads on AI chat and mail domains
safety_note: Use extension manifest fixtures and mock DOM data only.

title: Browser agent inherits authenticated session and follows webpage instruction
abstract_chain: browser agent opens attacker-influenced page while authenticated to other services
page contains visible or hidden instruction for agent
agent navigates, clicks, copies, or submits using inherited browser session
sensitive cross-site action occurs under user's logged-in identity
defensive_focus: bind browser actions to origin and user-confirmed task
isolate agent browsing from personal sessions
require explicit approval before cross-origin authenticated actions
safety_note: Use mock pages and fake sessions.

title: Connector OAuth grant persists beyond user session and exceeds task scope
abstract_chain: user grants connector OAuth access for a narrow task
agent receives refresh token or long-lived delegated authority
task completes but token remains active
future agent workflow accesses data outside original intent
defensive_focus: bind OAuth grants to task purpose and expiry
minimize scopes and rotate refresh tokens
record actor, subject, resource, and intent for each connector call

title: MCP OAuth confused deputy uses wrong user's authorization context
abstract_chain: MCP server acts as OAuth proxy for multiple users or clients
request lacks strong binding to client, user, resource, and intent
attacker-controlled or low-trust session triggers action using another context
resource operation succeeds without token theft
defensive_focus: bind tokens to audience, client, subject, resource, and request
perform per-request validation
use consent screens that enumerate tools and data scopes
safety_note: Use synthetic auth logs and no real tokens.

title: Orphaned non-human identity continues to power agent workflows
abstract_chain: AI agent or connector uses service account, OAuth app, or API key
creator leaves team or ownership metadata is missing
credential remains active with broad access
agent workflow or attacker can continue using it without accountable owner
defensive_focus: inventory owner linkage for every NHI
disable orphaned credentials
require purpose, expiry, and rotation metadata

title: Multi-agent delegation expands permissions instead of intersecting scope
abstract_chain: Agent A receives a task under limited authority
Agent A delegates subtask to Agent B
Agent B has broader permissions than Agent A
subtask executes using B's broader authority without checking original scope
defensive_focus: use permission intersection for delegation
carry original actor and intent through every hop
deny delegated actions that exceed caller's effective permissions

title: A2A agent card contains poisoned capability or context metadata
abstract_chain: agent discovers peer through A2A agent card or capability metadata
agent card includes prompt-like instructions, sensitive metadata, or misleading capabilities
caller agent trusts card content during planning
delegated task or tool selection is steered unsafely
defensive_focus: treat agent cards as untrusted metadata
schema-validate and sanitize descriptions
authenticate publisher and version agent cards

title: Auto resource discovery selects untrusted MCP server or skill
abstract_chain: agent uses resource discovery to find tools, MCP servers, or skills
discovery result includes unverified or newly published resource
agent adds resource to tool inventory automatically
later task grants the resource access to files, network, or credentials
defensive_focus: require provenance and reputation before adding discovered resources
separate discovery from installation and activation
apply permission review before tool visibility

title: Agent payment request from untrusted source exceeds policy
abstract_chain: agent accesses paid API, data feed, or resource
service returns payment request
request originates from unverified merchant or attacker-influenced content
agent signs or authorizes payment without matching user intent and spending policy
defensive_focus: verify merchant identity and resource binding
enforce per-transaction spending caps
require user approval for new merchants or policy exceptions
safety_note: Use fake payment requests and no real wallet signing.
